summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.93/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.93 a gallon across Wisconsin as of June 5, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 23¢ lower than a week ago, 39¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.04 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Fond du Lac ($3.69) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.17).
